content:
Apple TV's tvOS doesn't see new apps very often. WordPress has just launched WordPress TV, bringing video content to the big screen.

According to the app's description, WordPress TV is a brand new way to watch "thousands of free talks, tutorials, and WordCamp session recordings from WordPress meetups and events around the world" through Apple TV.

Here's the full app description for WordPress TV:

The WordPress community's video library, brought to your living room TV. WordPress TV brings the complete catalog of WordPress.tv to the big screen—featuring thousands of free talks, tutorials, and WordCamp session recordings from WordPress meetups and events around the world. Learn from the people who build and use WordPress every day, from the comfort of your couch. Built natively for Apple TV, it feels right at home in your living room: browse a clean grid of posters with the remote, press to play, and enjoy smooth full-screen HD video. What you can watch includes • Session recordings from WordCamp events around the world • Covering design, development, business, and content

You can download WordPress TV from the App Store on Apple TV.
